ns2:course.label: Seminar
ns2:course.description: Group discussion or an experimental course on a special topic in agricultural and consumer economics. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in the same semester to 4 hours, or subsequent terms to a maximum of 12 hours as topics vary.
